description: Change where an existing short code goes, or fix its tags, WITHOUT changing the code. Use this whenever a live link points at the wrong offer or carries a typo'd campaign — never delete and recreate: the code is already out in an email or a post, so it would 404 in between and lose the click history that shows how the campaign performed. Tags MERGE, so passing only utm_campaign leaves the rest alone; pass an empty string to clear one field. Refuses to leave the link without a usable source, since that would report every click as 'direct'.

offer.description: Re-point at this offer slug or ID

path.description: Re-point at a path on gocushy.com instead
